comparison.objective: Allocate ABO-compatible blood units to patient trays, versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Rule-based selection, arm-to-arm handover, and tray placement versus precision tool use and dynamic mechanical tuning.
comparison.success_condition: O, A, and B patients receive compatible specified units while AB remains stored versus repeated safe stops within mechanical limits and a stable locked setting.
comparison.reason: This primarily tests compatibility reasoning and object allocation. No spec versions are present; the body does not provide placement tolerances or a complete numeric rubric.
